header:
# Town of Proctor municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Proctor, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting (signed January 26, 2026; floor meeting March 2, 2026 and Australian ballot March 3, 2026): the ballot articles elect a Moderator for a one-year term. The 2023 report's table names Andrew Maass (term to 2024); no official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Proctor elects the clerk to a three-year term

Town of Proctor, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting (signed January 26, 2026; floor meeting March 2, 2026 and Australian ballot March 3, 2026): the ballot articles elect a Town Clerk for a three-year term

Town of Proctor, Town Clerk & Treasurer page (proctorvermont.com): Celia Lisananti is the Town Clerk. Her three-year term expired at the 2026 meeting and the seat stood; she is recorded as the continuing clerk on the town's maintained clerk page and contact directory (incumbent continuity, disclosed)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Celia Lisananti as Proctor's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer; Proctor elects the treasurer to a three-year term

Town of Proctor, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting (signed January 26, 2026; floor meeting March 2, 2026 and Australian ballot March 3, 2026): the ballot articles elect a Town Treasurer for a three-year term
Town of Proctor, Town Clerk & Treasurer page (proctorvermont.com): Celia Lisananti is the Town Treasurer; see the clerk note on incumbent continuity
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Celia Lisananti as Proctor's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Proctor's five selectboard members: Bruce Baccei, Linda Doty, Lisa Miser, Jason Thornton, and Albert Wenta
Town of Proctor, Selectboard page (proctorvermont.com): Lisa Miser, Chair; Bruce Baccei, Vice Chair; Linda Doty; Albert Wenta; and Jay Thornton (the directory's Jason Thornton)

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Proctor Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes for a one-year term unless the town votes a longer term

Town of Proctor, 2023 Annual Report, Elected Officials table (the report posted on the town website): the table gives the Collector of Delinquent Taxes its own three-year term (Celia Lisananti); the seat did not stand in 2026
Town of Proctor, Town Clerk & Treasurer page: Celia Lisananti 'also serves as the collector of current and delinquent taxes'

Town of Proctor, Cemetery Commission page (proctorvermont.com): 'The Riverside Cemetery Commissioner is Albert Wenta... Since there is no Commission other than Albert Wenta' -- Proctor's cemetery commission is a single commissioner, on a five-year term expiring in 2028
